component.title: Input
component.purpose: Provide a token-bound text-entry control that remains recognizable across text, search, and disabled examples.

priorities.statement: Each example communicates that it accepts or displays text input.
The search example remains a recognizable text-entry control.
The disabled example preserves context while preventing edits.

states.description: Text field with a component-name placeholder.
Disabled field that preserves its displayed value.

claims.statement: The text example renders a text-entry field.
The search example renders a text-entry field.
The disabled example still renders a text-entry field.
The disabled example cannot be edited while its displayed value remains available.
